name: PASCAL-Context
description: Whole-scene parsing dataset with 59 classes plus background. The related PASCAL-Part provides part-level annotations; PASCAL-Context is distinct from PASCAL VOC. No data is vendored in this record.
citation: Mottaghi, R., et al. (2014). The Role of Context for Object Detection and Semantic Segmentation in the Wild: PASCAL-Context. Proceedings of the IEEE Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR).
